Name: Monster Men Livestock
Author: CommanderWaddles
Description:
[color=#ffffff][font=Arial]This mod replaces vanilla livestock with sexy monster men. Each beast is a mythical or legendary creature with connections to Stardew Valley. 
[/font][/color]
[color=#ffffff][font=Arial][size=4][b]Content:[/b][/size][/font][/color][list]
[*][color=#ffffff][font=Arial]White Cow → Incubus[/font][/color]
[*][color=#ffffff][font=Arial]Brown Cow → Minotaur[/font][/color]
[*][color=#ffffff][font=Arial]Goat → Anubis[/font][/color]
[*][color=#ffffff][font=Arial]Sheep → Fluffy Centaur[/font][/color]
[*][color=#ffffff][font=Arial]Pig → Basilisk [/font][/color]
[/list][list]
[*][color=#ffffff][font=Arial]Animal Shop Menu icons are replaced[/font][/color]
[*][color=#ffffff][font=Arial]Animal descriptions now correspond to the following monster[/font][/color]
[*][font=Arial]Purchased animals will start off as babies and evolve into Monster Men once they have reached adulthood. For example, a baby brown cow will evolve into a Minotaur once it hits maturity. No monster babies for you. Big sad.[/font][color=#ffffff][font=Arial][/font][/color]
[/list][size=4][color=#ffffff][font=Arial]
[/font][/color][color=#ffffff][b][font=Arial]Installation:
[/font][/b][/color][/size][color=#ffffff][font=Arial]1)   Make sure you have "SMAPI" and "Content Patcher" installed.
[/font][/color][color=#ffffff][font=Arial]2)   Download this mod “[CP] Monster Men Livestock” and unzip into your Mods folder.
3)   Enjoy your new sexy beasts!  

Note: Please do not make a BFAV version without my permission. I will also be taking suggestions for adding other monster men to this mod. Anyone interested in seeing a male dryad in a future update? Let me know what your favorite monsters are so far!

I used peroxidewren's "Adventure Time Hairstyles" and Monmsky's "Monster Girl Livestock" mods as the base for the Fluffy Centaur sprite. Melnoelle's "UnderDark Sewer" was used as the background for the Incubus lore.

[/color][/font][center][font=Calibri][color=#b00000][img]http://oi67.tinypic.com/2cs8d54.jpg[/img][/color][/font][/center][font=Calibri][color=#b6b6b6][size=4]A legendary monster that appeared from the abysmal depths of [color=#ffffff]Skull Cavern[/color]. Rumors say that he was worshipped as the guardian of [color=#ffffff]Calico[/color] [color=#ffffff]Desert[/color].
[color=#ffffff]Sandy[/color] recalls from a popular bedtime story that Anubis is the patron of lost souls, guiding wandering mummies back into eternal slumber. He loves goat milk and will sometimes offer some to the farmer.

Wool will sporadically grow all over his body, causing him to be laughed at by his peers.

He is constantly aroused and will attempt to seduce the farmer, shamelessly producing high quality ‘milk’ right before the farmer’s eyes.
The people of Pelican Town fall in love with the dairy product and keep asking for more, but the farmer refuses to meet their eyes.

Downloads.Description:
Make sure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed. Download this mod and unzip it into your Mods folder.
A few small bugs were fixed.
Please let me know what you think of the mod!
